en.stem: Which of the following signals is monotonic?
en.quick: A monotonic signal consistently moves in only one direction (non-increasing or non-decreasing) over its domain. Simplify each candidate and/or inspect its derivative; the keyed choice is the expression that reduces to a monotonic function.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संकेत एकदिष्ट (monotonic) है?
hi.quick: C — sin²(2t) + cos²(2t) = 1, अतः x(t) = 1 − 2t, जिसका अवकलज −2 हमेशा ऋणात्मक है — यह एकदिष्ट ह्रासमान है। t³ − 2t, sin t और log(cos t) दिशा बदलते हैं।

gu.quick: C — sin²(2t) + cos²(2t) = 1, તેથી x(t) = 1 − 2t, જેનું વિકલજ −2 હંમેશા ઋણ છે — તે એકદિશ ઘટતો છે. t³ − 2t, sin t અને log(cos t) દિશા બદલે છે.
